**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer)

- **No Customer-payable LD exists.** Searches for "liquidated", "penalty", "termination fee" and "minimum" return no stipulated-damages or early-termination/minimum-fee obligation running against IBM. Sections 5.1–5.3 (Breach / Rights & Prices Upon Termination) impose no termination charge on us.
- **The one "penalty" runs against MSL.** SOW § 7.3 b) (p0757) applies a percentage penalty to the Work Center's material cost for MSL's responsiveness misses, and p0758 confirms it "will be invoiced by IBM to MSL" — effectively a vendor-side service credit, which the playbook treats as compliant.
- **Amounts we do bear are cost recovery, not penalties:** parts/inventory buyback at MSL's cost (p0143), premium cost reimbursement (§ 9.0), Transferred Employee termination benefits (p0186) and actual MVS licence charges (p1225). Purchase Order cancellation carries no charge where MSL is in default (p0722).

This sits at the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
